notes.summary: Original short summary of the Journal of Endocrinology (JOE) Research-paper rules for the scientific-manuscript skill. It paraphrases the author guidelines and quotes none of them; the live page controls. Re-verify every value before submission.
notes.journal: Sources (the journal's author page and its author-guidelines page, both read from a pasted snapshot) with retrieval date and method, plus the conflicts between the journal pages and the joint JOE/JME checklist and how they were resolved. reverify_before_submission stays true because no rule was read from the live pages.
notes.article_types: Limits for a Research paper. The word limit excludes references and figure legends; figure and reference maxima are recommendations.
notes.title_page: The title page is a separate file and must match the submission-system entries exactly.
notes.declarations: The journal's declaration order. Wording guidance is paraphrased; copy the journal's standard sentences from the live page when drafting.
notes.formatting: Double spacing everywhere, references and legends included; continuous line numbers; one English variety used consistently.
notes.references: Numbered Vancouver style in citation order through EndNote.
notes.statistics: Journal expectations for analysis reporting. p_style and p_italic are house choices: the journal gives no rule, and its own examples space the operator.
notes.figures: Figure preparation and file rules. max_width_mm is an assumption because the journal publishes none.
notes.tables: Tables are separate editable files without internal rules or shading.
notes.supplementary: Supplementary items are numbered without an 'S' prefix.
notes.revision: Revisions mark changes by highlight or coloured text with a point-by-point response; whether native tracked changes are accepted is unverified.
notes.policies: Ethics, consent, data, preprint and AI-disclosure expectations.
notes.package: What the submission package contains and its size budget.
notes.image_integrity: Rules for processing images and blots.

conflicts.reason: the journal-specific page controls; re-verify at submission

conflicts.a: checklist: one resolution for every figure
conflicts.b: journal author guidelines: resolution tiers by figure type
conflicts.reason: the journal-specific page controls; record the tier of each figure

guidance.declaration_of_interest: State any conflict of interest; when there is none, use the journal's standard sentence from the live page.
guidance.funding: Name each funder with its grant number in one funding sentence in the journal's standard form; use the journal's no-funding sentence when there is none.
guidance.author_contributions: Contributions per author, using CRediT roles.
guidance.acknowledgements: People and services that helped but are not authors.
guidance.ai_disclosure: Name any generative AI tool with its version, model and source, and say what it was used for.

statistics.multiple_comparisons: use a multiple-comparison procedure rather than repeated t tests

figures.symbols: closed and open circles, squares and triangles, legible after reduction

image_integrity.adjustments: whole-image only and disclosed; no selective enhancement
image_integrity.blots: keep uncropped originals; crops show at least two markers; spliced lanes demarcated
